column1: # Unlisted code blocks that something in the image DOES point at.
# Drawn from unlisted-code-blocks.tsv by intersecting each block start with four static
# reference forms: .pdata ranges, direct call/jmp targets, rip-relative lea targets, and the
# values stored at DIR64 base-relocation sites.
# 143 blocks, 6,038 bytes. 129 of the 135 call-referenced ones are called ONLY from other
# unlisted code; the fourteen with a listed caller are decoded on
# referenced-code-the-list-never-had.md and every one of them is reached by a tail jmp.
